title: Substitution Plan
description: substitution-plan/v1 — the assets to move into the container and the posted positions to recall, named by whoever calculated them. Which assets satisfy a call, and how much of each, is the calculator's judgement rather than the valuation engine's: the engine states how much is owed, this states what would settle it. A plan is a PROPOSAL, not a decision — parting with a posted position needs the counterparty's consent, so an agreed substitution thread remains what authorises execution.

planId.description: Identity of this plan, so a later event can cite it.

reportId.description: The report whose obligation this plan would settle.

proposedBy.description: The organization proposing it. Events carry roles rather than organizations, so the document pins the organization.

in.description: Positions to post into the container.

out.description: Posted positions to recall from the container. Empty on a plain post; a substitution names at least one.
